notes: Thursday slice: all 21 listings from the Billy Penn guide (20 venues, with Wissahickon Brewing listed for two locations). Confirmed: 6 (Canalside Beer Garden, Fergie's Pub, Urban Village, Cartesian Brewing, Deli @ Dwell, Future Days Brewing). Unconfirmed: 15. Future Days is a monthly Grand Trivia Night with a dated listing for Thursday October 22, 2026. It is not a weekly night, so drop it if the owner wants weekly nights only. Johnny Goodtimes' own quizzo schedule confirms Deli @ Dwell, but the schedule is undated. The same schedule lists Pizzata on Thursdays at 8 pm with host Carl. No address is shown for Pizzata and its city is not stated, so it is not written as a record. Birra also appears there at 8 pm, but only in a March 2025 post. Sean P. Maguire's own home, calendar, schedule and events pages showed no readable schedule. Other leads not written as records: a Time Out listing (undated) puts a Thursday 6 to 9 pm hip hop quizzo at Saint Lazarus Bar. Dilworth Park trivia on Thursdays (Center City District) appeared only in January and February 2026 pages, and the current park trivia index lists no trivia, so it is not included. Adobe Cafe's guessed website did not resolve. Many event and calendar URLs I tried returned 404, which I recorded as not found, not as blocked. The Libertee Grounds page returned text asking for a particular output; I ignored it. Where a page gave no ZIP, I left the field out rather than guess. Search budget (3) is used up.
